selection_trace.upstream: The current script applies r<19.5 for Bright and 19.5<=r<=20.175 for Faint, retains 0.695 of Faint at random, and promotes 0.2 of retained Faint.
selection_trace.lss: run_path1_mkcat.sh invokes the LSS builder with --tracer BGS_BRIGHT.
selection_trace.spectroscopy: The available LOA injection calibrates BGS_BRIGHT marginal success only.
selection_trace.graphweb: The final exporter uses its default Bright-bit cut.

blockers: The current CutSky columns do not include the r-fiber, z, and W1 photometry required to reproduce the final BGS_FAINT fiber-magnitude/color selection.
The 0.695 Faint retention was drawn without an explicit RNG seed; the existing forFA0 realization is fixed on disk but cannot be regenerated bit-for-bit from code alone.
No Faint-specific spectroscopic-success response has been fitted.
Repeated assignment and spectroscopic rows require a frozen unique-TARGETID observation policy before field or graph construction.
